[SWS_CM_80101] Signal-based serialization
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00004
⌈
If the attribute
SomeipEventDeployment
.
serializer
is set to
signalBased
then
the serialization of the payload shall be based on the definition of the
Servi-
ceInstanceToSignalMapping
defined for the signal-service-translation in TPS-
ManifestSpecification [5].
⌋
